title: gagea polymorpha var. nevadensis
intro: Gagea polymorpha var. nevadensis, commonly known as Nevada spring beauty, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Liliaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues, such as inflammation and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Gagea polymorpha var. nevadensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help in soothing coughs and relieving congestion. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
